checkers.title: Checkers
checkers.description: Play real-time Checkers with friends. Capture all opponent pieces or block them to win!
checkers.confirmSurrender: Are you sure you want to surrender?
checkers.sharePeerId: Share this Peer ID with your opponent:

rules.rule1: Red moves first. Pieces move diagonally forward.
rules.rule2: Capture opponent pieces by jumping over them.
rules.rule3: If you can capture, you must capture.
rules.rule4: Reach the opposite end to become a King (can move backwards).
rules.rule5: Win by capturing all opponent pieces or blocking all their moves.
